trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. There is no separate task — it is the reward for finishing everything: the story, the stranger missions, the collectibles, the races and the one-time moments. Keep the missable list in mind from the start, because a missed one-time moment is the only thing that can force a second playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission — play through the intro as Lucia and Jason until the fishing trip ends and the chapter card lands. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. It is the first trophy most players earn and the gateway to the open world.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The chapter ends with a story beat that closes the opening act, and the trophy pops as the Chapter 2 title card appears. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions. The chapter is built around the drug-money plotline, and the trophy unlocks at its final mission's conclusion. Keep an eye on the missable moments in this stretch — several one-time partner scenes happen here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 3, which opens up Vice City proper. The trophy lands when the chapter's final mission wraps. By now the map is mostly open, so it is a good moment to clear nearby activities before moving on.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's story missions. This is the penultimate chapter, and its finale sets up the endgame — the trophy pops at the chapter close. Make sure the missable partner moments are done before the finale, as the endgame changes who is available.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Play the final story mission to its end and watch the credits roll. This is the last story trophy; it unlocks the moment the finale resolves. After it, the world stays open for cleanup, so nothing is locked out by finishing.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Complete the 'Breakfast Run' story mission. It is a Lucia and Jason job that tests the pair's trust — follow the mission markers, complete the objective, and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. It is unmissable as part of the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete 'The Cartel Heist' story mission. This is a big set-piece heist — plan the approach the mission offers, execute it, and the trophy unlocks when the crew gets away clean. Part of the main story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the 'Child's Play' story mission. The mission centers on family business in Leonida; follow it to its conclusion and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Unmissable, story-tied.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the 'Headliners' story mission. This is a high-profile job with a public fallout — finish the mission's objectives and the trophy unlocks. Story-tied and unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the 'VCIA Takedown' story mission at Vice City International Airport. The mission involves taking down a target at the airport — finish it and the trophy pops. Unmissable, story-tied.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete 'Operation Savage Glory', the story's big military-style operation. It is one of the longest missions in the game — work through its phases and the trophy unlocks at the end. Unmissable, story-tied.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats. That means finishing the story, all stranger missions, all activities, all collectibles, all stunts and all challenges the game counts. Use the checklist in this guide to track what remains — the last few percent are almost always a missed collectible or an unfinished activity set.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps across Leonida. Stunt jumps are the ramps marked on the map — hit them at speed and land them. There are far more than 250 in the world, so pick the easy ones near roads you already use and grind them out between missions. The counter is in the stats menu.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game at least once — races, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade games, meditation spots and the rest. The trophy pops the moment you try the last untried type. Use the activities list in this guide to see which types you have not touched yet.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the shooting ranges and earn a gold medal in every challenge. Each challenge has a score threshold for gold — use the weapon the challenge specifies, aim for headshots where they count double, and retry until you beat the gold line. There are 42 challenges in total, so budget an evening for this one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the race locations. Drone races are time trials through rings — learn each course's line, cut corners where the rings allow, and win at every spot. The locations are marked once you discover them.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each is a different event. You do not need to win the same race twice; variety is the requirement. Pick a fast, well-handling car and work through the race map markers.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and beat him. Fishing is a timing mini-game — hook the fish, keep the tension in the green zone, and reel steadily without snapping the line. Cal's score is the bar; beat it once and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any arcade machine to completion. Arcade cabinets are in bars and arcades around Vice City — pick one, play through a full game, and the trophy pops when you finish it. Any game counts, so choose the shortest one.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand. Andy's missions appear as a stranger marker — complete each one in order until the final mission, and the trophy unlocks at its end. Stranger missions are easy to overlook, so clear them as they appear.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, which revolves around boats and the Leonida waterways. Complete each of his missions in turn; the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand. Billy's missions are biker-themed — complete them all in order and the trophy unlocks after the final ride.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands. Strangers are the '?' markers — each has a short chain of missions. Work through eight different strangers' chains and the trophy pops. There are more than eight strangers, so you can skip any chain you dislike.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand. Randy's chain is about supply runs — complete each mission in order and the trophy unlocks at the finale.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand. Complete his missions in order until the last one; the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find every meditation spot in Leonida and meditate at each one. The spots are scenic overlooks — sit, meditate, and move to the next. The counter tracks how many you have done; the trophy pops at the last spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting strand gives you a target — track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring proof back. Use a scoped rifle and approach downwind so the animal does not bolt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses and odd corners. Each set has a fixed number of cards; finish any three sets and the trophy pops. Use the card checklist to track which sets you are close on.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to check in at 100 locations. Open WAiNK at a landmark, tag it, and move on — the count climbs as you travel. It pairs naturally with exploration, so do it while clearing the map for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the small objectives scattered through activities — races, stunts, hunting, fishing and more. They accumulate naturally as you play; if you are short near the end, grind the quickest ones (stunt jumps and short races).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in an open area with a fast car ready — break line of sight, hide until the stars flash, then stay out of the search cone. This is a partner moment, so do it while your partner is available in the story; it is missable if you leave it too late.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping. Keep the robberies quick — hit the till, get out, and move to the next shop before the heat fades. Plan a route of three close shops and a getaway car. Missable if attempted after your partner is no longer available.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts — cars, bikes, boats, planes. The counter is in the stats menu; it climbs fastest if you steal a variety of traffic rather than driving one car everywhere.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down five enemies before it ends. Find a spot with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the kills — headshots keep the meter going. A gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout is the easiest place to line up five targets.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — steal a plane and take off without clearance, or otherwise leave the airport in a way the game flags as unscheduled. The simplest route is to grab a plane on the tarmac and get airborne before security closes in. It is a one-time airport moment, so do it while the airport is freely accessible.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Get inside a Rhino tank and survive the heat that follows. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and military spots — steal one, ride out the response, and the trophy pops once you have held it through the encounter. Do it when you have the firepower and armor to back it up.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without tripping the alarm or being spotted. Go in quiet — mask up, avoid the cameras, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are detected, the attempt fails, so save first and retry the stealth approach.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big heist targets — crack the vault, grab the cash, and get away clean. Each successful vault robbery counts; you do not need to do all five in one run.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks roam the roads — ram one to stop it, crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. Any truck counts, so pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every named area of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive, fly and sail through every region until the whole state is revealed. It pairs well with the WAiNK check-ins and vehicle discovery, so combine all three in one long road trip.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own rackets — hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops. The operations are marked once you discover them; work through the gangs one by one.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Sit down for a cocktail at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet, one-time story-adjacent moment — find the beachfront bar, order the cocktail, and enjoy the view until the trophy pops. Do it when the option appears; it is easy to walk past and miss.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass front and out the other side, in the classic GTA style. Pick a showroom, build speed on the approach, and smash through — the trophy pops when you exit the building in the car. It is a one-time stunt moment, so save before you try it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on the moment there — bowl a full game and see the scene to its end. The alley is in Vice City; the trophy pops when the follow-through completes. It is tied to a specific visit, so do not rush past it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Reach the partnership milestone the trophy describes — a public, crowd-pleasing moment with your partner that the game flags as a personal best. It triggers during a specific partner activity; play through the partner content as it comes and the trophy pops when the moment lands.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make the choice the story offers and live with it. This trophy is tied to a branching decision — pick a side and the trophy pops once the consequences play out. Because the choice is one-time, save before the decision if you want to see the other branch later.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Fail at something once, then succeed on the second try. The trophy is tied to a specific second-attempt moment — the game tracks a failed attempt and rewards the retry. If you succeed first time, you will need the other branch or a replay to trigger it, so it is genuinely missable.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Trigger the strange event the trophy names — an easter egg encounter out in Leonida that leaves both characters wondering what just happened. It is a hidden, off-the-beaten-path moment; follow the clues (unusual lights, odd sounds) to the spot and let the scene play.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

source.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl over ten pins with a melee drive-by — drive past a group and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle to knock them down. It takes a steady hand and a slow drive-by; line up a group of pedestrians, swing as you pass, and count the pins. Do it in a quiet area to avoid the cops.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies — hand them to your laundering contacts and the clean cash counts toward the total. It accumulates across the whole game, so keep laundering after every big score.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything that takes cash. It is cumulative and counts every shop, so it finishes naturally if you buy gear as you go; if you are short, splurge on a car mod.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. There are eight garages — each is a property you can purchase once you have the cash. Buy them all and the trophy pops. Garages also store your vehicles, so they are worth owning anyway.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, add a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until ten are registered. Any vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive.
trophies.name: On the Spot
